    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    App
    JavaFX application entry point.
    AppConfig
    The root of the application's configuration, combining viewport, match, and control settings.
    ApplicationScreen
    Identifies a full-screen area currently displayed by the application.
    AppNavigator
    Coordinates full-screen application navigation and the active gameplay lifecycle.
    Arena
    Represents the rectangular playing field, including its boundary walls.
    ArenaConfig
    The configurable spacing and wall thickness used to size the in-game Arena.
    Ball
    Encapsulates the ball's mutable position and velocity.
    BallConfig
    The configurable size, initial velocity, and speed-up behavior for the in-game Ball.
    BallGameUpdater
    A GameUpdater that advances the ball's position for one frame, delegating wall- and paddle-bounce physics to BallMovement.
    BallMovement
    Pure physics for advancing a ball's position by one frame and resolving wall and paddle collisions.
    BallView
    A read-only view of a ball's position, size, and velocity.
    ConfigLoader
    Loads AppConfig from a bundled YAML resource on the classpath.
    ConfigRepository
    Loads and saves user configuration on the filesystem, falling back to ConfigLoader's bundled defaults when no user configuration exists or it cannot be read.
    ConfigValidation
    Validation helpers shared by the configuration schema's compact constructors, used to reject invalid values with a consistent, descriptive message.
    ControlsConfig
    The key bindings for both paddles.
    DefaultButton
    A consistently styled button for the application's user interface.
    DefaultCheckBox
    A consistently styled checkbox for the application's user interface.
    DefaultTextField
    A consistently styled text field for the application's user interface.
    GameLoop
    Drives the game's per-frame loop: on every JavaFX animation frame, it updates the GameSession state and then renders it.
    GamePageConfig
    The configuration for a single match: arena, ball, and paddle settings, plus the score needed to win.
    GamePageRenderer
    Composes the gameplay Scene: the PongRenderer canvas, with the PauseMenuRenderer and GameWinnerBannerRenderer overlaid on top when shown.
    GameplayController
    Owns the JavaFX and game-loop objects for one active gameplay session.
    GameSession
    Holds the full mutable state of a Pong match: the arena, both paddles, the ball, the score, and the match's GameStatus.
    GameStatus
    The lifecycle state of a GameSession.
    GameUpdater
    Updates a game state for one frame.
    GameWinnerBannerRenderer
    Builds the winner banner overlay shown when a match finishes: which player won, and the key bindings to start a new match or quit.
    Main
    Standalone launcher for App.
    MainMenuRenderer
    Creates the application's main-menu scene.
    MatchSettings
    The subset of match settings a player can edit from the options menu: winning score, ball and paddle speed, and whether ball speed increases on paddle bounces.
    OptionsButton
    A consistently styled button for the application's Options menu.
    OptionsController
    Owns the options screen, validating and saving the match and control settings edited there.
    OptionsPageRenderer
    Builds and drives the options screen: editable fields for match settings, rebindable paddle control buttons, and save/back actions.
    Paddle
    Encapsulates a paddle's mutable vertical position and fixed dimensions.
    PaddleConfig
    The configurable size, arena inset, and speed for each in-game Paddle.
    PaddleControlsConfig
    The key bindings that move a single paddle up and down.
    PaddleDirection
    The direction a paddle is currently moving in, as driven by player input.
    PaddleGameUpdater
    A GameUpdater that advances both paddles for one frame, based on the current player input, delegating movement physics to PaddleMovement.
    PaddleInputState
    Holds the current movement direction for each paddle, as derived from player input.
    PaddleKeyMapping
    Translates raw JavaFX key codes into paddle movement directions, based on the key bindings configured for each paddle.
    PaddleMovement
    Pure physics for advancing a paddle's vertical position by one frame, based on its current movement direction.
    PaddleView
    A read-only view of a paddle's position, size, and speed.
    PauseMenuRenderer
    Builds the pause menu overlay: a "Match Paused" panel with resume and quit buttons, dimmed over the gameplay behind it.
    Player
    Identifies one of the two sides in a match.
    PongRenderer
    Draws a GameSession's arena, ball, paddles, and score onto a JavaFX Canvas.
    ScoreGameUpdater
    A GameUpdater that detects when the ball has crossed the arena's left or right inner boundary, awards a point to the opposing player, and starts the next round.
    ViewportConfig
    The size of the application window, in pixels.
